lead: Kevin Pietersen has built a public profile as a South African cricketer, born on 27 June 1980 in Pietermaritzburg.
As of 2026, he is 46 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented England cricket team and KwaZulu-Natal cricket team and has been recognised with Member of the Order of the British Empire and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
